description: Urban Waste Water Treatment Regulations (UWWTR) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Wales. 'Urban waste water' is defined in the Urban Waster Water Treatment Regulations (UWWTR) as the mixture of domestic waste water from kitchens, bathrooms and toilets, the waste water from industries discharging to sewers, and rainwater run-off from roads and other impermeable surfaces such as roofs, pavements and roads draining to sewers. Coverage: Natural Resources Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Wales. Its tags are urban waste water treatment. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
